verdicts.reason: Both put the oversized 'Shop Flavours' CTA hard against the left canvas edge, before the brand and headline, so the reading order runs backwards. Both reverse the flavour pills, squeeze the subhead into a cramped two-line wrap beside them, and float tiny, unreadable legal text in a dead right half. B is worse because the SOLSTICE wordmark collides with the headline descenders and the pills are jammed right under it, while A at least keeps a small gap between the headline, wordmark and pills.
